llm.py comment states the anthropic>=0.40 floor predates the output_config SDK parameter; the issue says this is not established.
'Some models reject any temperature' rationale repeated across four files, each naming one model.
No test sets temperature and effort together and checks the payload carries both.

## Code Review Findings
### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (4)
<details><summary>4 items</summary>

1. The set of allowed effort values is defined twice, in `src/sqllens/config.py` (lines 89-91) and in `src/sqllens/agent/core/llm/models.py` (line 15). Only a unit test keeps the two copies equal; the type system does not. The comment explains this keeps config loading free of the agent package. (raised by 1/6 agents)
2. The comment in `src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py` (lines 217-218) says the `anthropic>=0.40` floor predates the SDK `output_config` parameter. The issue says this is not established, so the comment may state an open question as fact. Checklist item 3 judged the comment PASS, so this is not graded as a false claim. (raised by 1/6 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: code comment only; no tool reads it; extra_body use does not depend on the sentence -->
3. The reason "some models reject any temperature" is repeated in comments in `src/sqllens/config.py`, `src/sqllens/agent/core/llm/models.py`, `src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py` and `src/sqllens/agent/core/evaluation/evaluators.py`. Each copy names one model and may go stale. (raised by 1/6 agents)
4. `tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py` (lines 86-111) tests three of the four temperature and effort combinations. No test sets both together and checks that the payload carries both `temperature` and `extra_body.output_config`. (raised by 1/6 agents)

</details>

### ℹ️ Informational — Deferred
- VC-1: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — The anthropic SDK's messages.create and messages.stream accept an `extra_body` kwarg at the project floor anthropic>=0.40 and merge it into the JSON body, so output_config.effort reaches the API. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  pyproject.toml:30 sets anthropic>=0.40,<1; llm.py:218-221 puts output_config.effort in payload['extra_body']. The only anthropic SDK available is the venv copy at .prflow/tmp/venv (0.125.0, outside the views), where messages.py declares 'extra_body: Body | None' 14 times, so create/stream accept it in that version. The 0.40 source was not available, so I could not confirm extra_body existed at the floor. Missing evidence: anthropic 0.40.0 resources/messages.py (create/stream signatures) or its changelog.

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] With `[llm] temperature` unset, the request payload that `AnthropicLlmService` sends to `messages.create` and to `messages.stream` contains no `temperature` key.
- [ ] With `[llm] temperature = 0.2` (or `SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE=0.2`), the agent request payload contains `"temperature": 0.2`.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort` unset, the agent request contains no `output_config`.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort = "high"` (or `SQLLENS_LLM__EFFORT=high`), the agent request sends `output_config` equal to `{"effort": "high"}` to Anthropic.
- [ ] Each of exactly these 5 effort values — `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` — complete by construction, loads without error.
- [ ] An effort value outside that set (for example `SQLLENS_LLM__EFFORT=extreme`) makes `sqllens validate` exit non-zero with a message naming the `effort` field.
- [ ] A `temperature` outside 0–2 (for example `3`) makes `sqllens validate` exit non-zero with a message naming the `temperature` field.
- [ ] The evaluation judge's request carries no `temperature` key when its caller passes none.
